take: The Flyers announced they reinstated D Cam York from injured reserve, placed D Rasmus Ristolainen on injured reserve (retroactive to Oct. 24) and recalled F Jacob Gaucher from Lehigh Valley (AHL). Ristolainen has been a top-pair defenseman at 16:58 a night who kills penalties, and by how the coach has used his players, Nick Seeler (20:05 a night) is next in line for those minutes. York, back after averaging 21.82 minutes, has seen PHI take just 26% of the 5-on-5 chances with him on the ice, while Gaucher's 58% in limited minutes is a very small sample. PHI sit 3-7-3 with 40.5% of the overall expected goals (the quality of chances).
